title: Drumming with Sam Morgan's traveling band
summary: Russ played drums in the traveling Sam Morgan band during the Depression, before La Vida, with Andrew Morgan, Georgie Parker and Henry Horton.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: You played with his band too? Yeah. Not for a long time now, yes? Yeah, yeah.
You did? Mm-hmm. That's when I was doing all the traveling. Because there was a traveling band. I was deep in depression. That was way before I talked about Louis Dumais.
Was that before you played with the La Vida band?
Yeah, yeah. Uh-huh.
So after P or something? Yeah.
Mm-hmm. Before P or something.
Before P. Oh, before P.
Yeah. I see. That a thing I had to work that out, you know?
Yeah.
But I had to work my life out on a big old sheet of paper, a big old phrase. But somehow or rather I misplayed it some way. Yeah.

Do you remember? Uh, Andrew Morgan. Uh-huh.
